He laughs bitterly. “No cult, my friend. ‘Cult’ makes it sound 
understandable. And they do not belong to Aten. What can I 
say of them? They are murderers perhaps, ghouls more likely, but 
the merest pebbles under the feet of their master.” 
If you desire more information, go to 237. If you are finished 
here, go to 149.
